comparison.objective: Raise a machine edge with a pry bar and insert cribbing; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain lever load while placing a support block versus maintain screw orientation while tightening a jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Machine released onto the block with bar unloaded versus gripper opening retained after locking and cycling.
comparison.reason: Shared simultaneous bimanual force is generic; load transfer and torque-preserved adjustment are different abilities.
